{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The Administration requires drugmakers that raise prices faster than inflation to pay the difference back to Medicare.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Medicare will pass savings from drugmaker rebates on to consumers.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Over 750,000 seniors could save as much as $4,500 per over-priced dose.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will keep fighting to expand these rebates, applying them when drugmakers overcharge not just Medicare, but private insurers as well.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats are cracking down on improper drug patent listings.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Once companies drop their improper patent listings, other companies will be free to make cheaper alternatives.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The FTC's work has pushed three of the biggest makers of inhalers to lower prices to $35 a month, saving people with asthma hundreds of dollars a year.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Administration enacted rules to make hearing aids available over-the-counter, saving millions of Americans up to $3,000 a pair.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will continue the Administration's work to require that any drugs developed with taxpayer dollars be available to taxpayers, including at reasonable prices.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will keep working to lower drug prices by requiring more transparency from pharmacy benefit managers.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
